name: fp-sicem
description: Readable-prose mode ("sic 'em-dash"). In the prose the model writes (READMEs, docs, markdown, PR and commit bodies) it replaces the em-dash and its cousins with connectors every English reader can follow at speed, non-native readers included. Clearer, never dumbed down. Chat, code and comments are left alone. Modes: off, on (default).
